svg.text: FERROSIFT / ENGINEERING
Drive, tensioning and control interfaces
Localized views from the same solid assembly / preliminary packaging / no selected manufacturer internals
CONCEPT ONLY
NOT FOR FABRICATION
DRIVE DETAIL / top view / surrounding geometry cropped / 1:5
TAIL DETAIL / side view / surrounding geometry cropped / 1:5
180 MOTOR BODY
100 ADJUSTER ENVELOPE
DRIVE + SHAFT ENCODER
The motor, reducer and coupling indicate an installation concept. Encoder feedback is taken at the head shaft;
independent belt-slip measurement remains open. Power, reduction, torque, encoder resolution and duty cycle are not
selected.
METROLOGY INTERFACE
Datum A: nominal floor z0. B: belt centre plane y0. C: inlet plane x0. Map sensor data to the belt frame; keep camera
extrinsics and the final sensing datum in the same measured coordinate system.
TENSION + TRACKING
Slotted tail bearing mounts and threaded-adjuster envelopes allow a study of adjustment. The modeled screw is not a
thread specification. Usable stroke, locking, pretension and tracking authority must be engineered and tested.
SERVICE CONNECTIONS
Provide maintainable cable loops, separation from moving parts and a documented disconnect path. Cable fill, bend
radii, earthing, ingress, electrical design and air isolation are unresolved.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
